title: E-mail templates
description: Texts of the transactional e-mails per language. An event can override a template with its own text.

ORDER_CONFIRMATION_BANK_TRANSFER.name: Order confirmation (bank transfer)
ORDER_CONFIRMATION_BANK_TRANSFER.description: Sent after ordering with Vorkasse: bank details and payment reference.

PAYMENT_RECEIVED_TICKETS.name: Payment received & tickets
PAYMENT_RECEIVED_TICKETS.description: Sent when an order is paid: invoice and ticket PDFs attached.

PAYMENT_REMINDER.name: Payment reminder
PAYMENT_REMINDER.description: Dunning e-mail for unpaid bank-transfer orders.

ORDER_CANCELLED.name: Order cancelled
ORDER_CANCELLED.description: Sent when an order is cancelled or expires.

REFUND_CONFIRMATION.name: Refund confirmation
REFUND_CONFIRMATION.description: Sent when a refund or credit note was issued.

TICKETS_RESENT.name: Tickets resent
TICKETS_RESENT.description: Sent when an admin or the customer requests the tickets again.

CUSTOMER_EMAIL_VERIFICATION.name: Customer account: confirm e-mail
CUSTOMER_EMAIL_VERIFICATION.description: Link to verify the e-mail address of a customer account.

CUSTOMER_PASSWORD_RESET.name: Customer account: reset password
CUSTOMER_PASSWORD_RESET.description: Link to choose a new password.

CUSTOMER_LOGIN_LINK.name: Customer account: sign-in link
CUSTOMER_LOGIN_LINK.description: One-time link to sign in without a password.

SMTP_TEST.name: SMTP test message
SMTP_TEST.description: Sent by “Send test e-mail” in the e-mail settings.

ADMIN_INVITE.name: Admin portal: invitation
ADMIN_INVITE.description: Invitation with a one-time link to set the password.

ADMIN_PASSWORD_RESET.name: Admin portal: reset password
ADMIN_PASSWORD_RESET.description: Link to choose a new admin password.

ADDITIONAL_PAYMENT_REQUEST.name: Additional payment request
ADDITIONAL_PAYMENT_REQUEST.description: Sent when an admin changes tickets to a higher tariff: old and new price, link to confirm and pay.

ADDITIONAL_PAYMENT_REMINDER.name: Additional payment reminder
ADDITIONAL_PAYMENT_REMINDER.description: One reminder for an unpaid tariff-change request.

ADDITIONAL_PAYMENT_CANCELLED.name: Additional payment withdrawn
ADDITIONAL_PAYMENT_CANCELLED.description: Sent when a tariff-change request is cancelled: nothing has to be paid.

ADDITIONAL_PAYMENT_RECEIVED.name: Additional payment received
ADDITIONAL_PAYMENT_RECEIVED.description: Sent when an additional payment (tariff change) is booked: amount received, old and new tariff per ticket, explanation of the invoice correction, new invoice and new tickets attached.

ADDITIONAL_PAYMENT_SETTLED_BY_CREDIT.name: Tariff changed – settled with credit
ADDITIONAL_PAYMENT_SETTLED_BY_CREDIT.description: Sent when a tariff change is settled completely with an overpayment the customer already made: nothing to pay, old and new tariff per ticket, invoice correction and new tickets attached.

page.overrideHint: This text is used instead of the global template for orders of this event.
page.noOverrideYet: This event has no own text for this template yet. Create an override – it starts as a copy of the global template.
page.deleteOverrideDescription: The global template is used for this event again. The text of the override is lost.
page.overridesDescription: Give single events their own text for this template and language.
page.noEvents: There are no events without an override.

editor.subject: Subject
editor.activeHint: Inactive templates are skipped; another language or the global template is used instead.
editor.visualScope: The visual editor edits the message content. Header and footer of the layout are changed in the HTML source.
editor.sourceHint: Full HTML document. Tables and inline styles are the most reliable way to build e-mails. Unsafe elements (scripts, forms, frames, external styles) are removed when saving.
editor.lossy: The visual editor cannot show this message exactly (for example unusual tables or markup it does not know). You can keep editing in the HTML source, or open the visual editor anyway – unsupported markup may then be simplified as soon as you edit there.
editor.noVisual: This document has a custom layout – edit it in the HTML source.
editor.linkHint: https://…, mailto:…, tel:… or a placeholder such as {example}.
editor.plainTextHint: Shown by mail programs that cannot display HTML. Leave empty to generate it from the HTML automatically.
editor.resetDescription: Subject and body are replaced by the shipped default. Your changes are lost.
editor.isDefault: This is the unchanged default text.
editor.savedWarnings: Saved. Please check the notes below.

placeholders.title: Placeholders
placeholders.hint: Click to insert at the cursor. Values are escaped automatically.
placeholders.helpersHint: Show text only when a value exists: {ifExample}, or only when it is empty: {unlessExample}.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subject: Subject
preview.unavailable: No preview while the template has errors.

preview.testNotConfigured: SMTP is not configured yet. Set it up under Settings → E-mail first.
preview.emptyText: The plain-text version is generated from the HTML when the e-mail is sent.
